text: Local declarations shall initialize in declaration order using the exact object type. Initializer inputs shall be constants, entry parameters, earlier available declaration results, or complete nested local record initializers; the declaration's own result and later definitions shall be unavailable. No load, call, or arbitrary executable expression shall be implied.
